name: frame-overflow
title: Frame overflow
author: Aiden Zepp
description: useFrameOverflow: lets a Frame header collapse low-priority actions (hidden by @container/frame queries) into its overflow menu. Pair with frame; menu primitives are your own.
docs: Mark inline groups with data-overflow="name" and a frame container query such as @max-lg/frame:hidden, put triggerRef on the menu trigger and onOpenChange on the menu, then render hidden.name actions inside the menu.
